summary.text: Luke’s childhood friend leaves Imperial service and joins the rebellion. Biggs flies an X-wing at Yavin, where he is killed during the Death Star attack. His filmed Tatooine conversations belong to deleted material rather than a verified released cut in this review.

records.scope: First review of this existing legacy identity: all seven inherited fields assessed, sourced nominal height, original short description and selected biography/work/craft relationships. Not a complete biography or episode/credit inventory.
limitations: Tatooine is explicitly where Biggs grew up; the inherited homeworld relation is not promoted to an exact birth/origin claim. A separate grew_up_on relation records the supported childhood context.

The interview identifies the Tatooine conversations as deleted material. The current biography gallery includes those scenes and the Yavin reunion without an edition filter; it is not treated as an original-1977 cut inventory. No new edition or home-media dates are created.

The Antilles Extraction trivia names Biggs as an abandoned outline, while Hobbie’s generic Databank introduction mentions Biggs and its released-story history names Wedge/Sabine. That discrepancy remains documented; no Biggs Rebels connection is inferred.
The published height is the current source-profile nominal value, not a measured value for every screen age, costume or animation design.
